Head: `b4fb2cabde42738bbce7047bc0e8dce3d1698b20`

Predecessor: `2254b567a48f12f9de8fc4f23321695753ca66cf`
Merge parents: `d2409126` and `c9534f004422c23b7899d2af01a8960843e06681`

## Threshold

The score that controls this round’s 9-point bar is the scoped restart correction below. **PASS 9/10.**

Full GRE-408 issue readiness is a separate score: **FAIL 6/10.** It does not control this round. Storage receipts are not route or worker acceptance. Do not merge from this comment. Hosted CI on this head was still running at the single check snapshot below.

## Scoped restart correction — PASS 9/10

| Item | Score |
|---|---|
| Acceptance criteria (crash/retry fencing) | 3/3 |
| Tests / CI | 1/2 |
| Runtime evidence (no UI) | 2/2 |
| Logs | 2/2 |
| Diff scope | 1/1 |
| **Total** | **9/10 PASS** |

Criteria met on the correction: a child `process::exit(28)` skips `Drop` and leaves the running job plus `.desktop-owner.json`. Reopen uses the same job id, attempt 2, generation 3. Duplicate enqueue returns that id. A second claim is empty. Stale heartbeat and `Finish` return `Stale attempt fence` and leave the record and history unchanged. Succeeded state survives another reopen.

`schema::preflight` calls `guard_unowned_marker`, which only reads the marker and calls `crate::lease::ensure_stale_owner`. It does not delete the marker. `StorageLease::acquire` still takes the exclusive lock, validates again, then renames the marker. The helper lives in `lease/guard.rs` and is re-exported crate-private from `lease.rs`. `storage_lease.rs` is gone. `durable_jobs.rs` is byte-identical between `d2409126` and this head.

Tests/CI is 1/2 because the focused test and the recorded suites passed, and Evidence lint is green on this head, while required hosted checks are still open. That missing point is unfinished CI, not a product failure found in the crash path.

## Issue readiness — FAIL 6/10 (does not control the 9 bar)

| Item | Score |
|---|---|
| Full GRE-408 acceptance | 1/3 |
| Tests / CI | 1/2 |
| Runtime evidence | 1/2 |
| Logs | 2/2 |
| Diff scope | 1/1 |
| **Total** | **6/10 FAIL** |

Open blockers:

- Ownership audit at `2254b567` lists 28 `/api/v1/jobs` routes, all `compat`. `git diff 2254b567..b4fb2cab` does not change server route files.
- Production callers of `AtomicJobClient` / `job_worker` are absent outside `pp-storage`, `jobs-fixture`, and an auth HTTP test.
- No `SQLITE_FULL`, ENOSPC, or disk-full test under `rust/`.
- Recorded `pp-storage` 155/155 and claims 15/15 do not prove route cutover, worker switch, or disk-full behavior.

The durable store does persist tenant, kind, state, version, generation, `lease_until`, an idempotency key table, and attempt/result inside the job document. Kind and per-resource admission exist in `claim`. Those storage facts are why criteria is 1/3 rather than 0/3.

## What this review ran

Clean tree at the head above.

`cargo test -p pp-storage --test durable_jobs ticket_t_28_claims_crash_retry_fences_stale_updates -- --exact --nocapture` from `rust/`:

`ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 76 filtered out; finished in 1.69s`

Canonical red, published and local bytes match: reopen panics with `Data directory already owned` at `durable_jobs.rs:1486`, `0 passed; 1 failed`, exit 101. https://github.com/poitee/PrintPartner/blob/d85860ac993200391be7974b7dc47ad82b52505a/crash-red-reproduced.log

Published round2 `crash.log` matches local and shows the same test `ok` after the fix. https://github.com/poitee/PrintPartner/blob/e3b1ba8c1ac19e4fc214e0ba21ed9f2ecddf5df8/round2/crash.log

Source sha256 of `schema.rs`, `lease.rs`, `lease/guard.rs`, and `durable_jobs.rs` matches https://github.com/poitee/PrintPartner/blob/e3b1ba8c1ac19e4fc214e0ba21ed9f2ecddf5df8/round2/source-hashes.json and the worktree.

This review did not re-run fmt, Clippy, boundaries, the 155 storage tests, the 15 claims tests, or the 9 Core marker tests. Those are the recorded logs, hash-bound for the four sources above.

## Logs and decisions.tsv

Recorded counts match the files: `storage-final.log` 152/152 at `d2409126`; round2 `storage.log` 155/155 including the crash test; `claims-final.log` 15 passed / 243 skipped; round2 `claims.log` 15 passed / 248 skipped. Initial Core log is 3 passed / 6 failed. Refreshed Core log is 9/9. The six failures are a stale release manifest setup, kept distinct from the later pass. Four panics print `Release artifact content mismatch`. `core_death_with_live_child_refuses_standalone_node` fails on missing `PP_CORE_READY`. `stale_owner_recovery_admits_only_one_concurrent_start` fails on `exactly one concurrent owner must acquire storage`. round2 README compresses all six into the mismatch sentence. The raw log is the authority.

`/tmp/gre408-evidence/decisions.tsv`:

- `14:17:55Z` cites `crash-red-before-fix.log` as `1 failed`. That file is now byte-identical to `crash-retry-test.log` and both show `1 passed`. Those two drafts stay excluded. `14:29:37Z` correctly switches the canonical red to `crash-red-reproduced.log`.
- `14:28:17Z` says the duplicate Core run was cancelled and is not a pass. `storage-and-markers-final.log` shows `Cancelling due to interrupt` and a nextest `SIGINT` summarized as `1 failed`. That summary is the interrupt, and the row does not claim a pass.
- `14:07:14Z` “17 checks passed” is an earlier PR 134 note. It does not describe this head.
- `14:35:12Z` 152 storage / 15 claims / 9 Core and `14:47:15Z` 155 storage / 15 claims / 9 Core match the logs named above.

## Comment Sicko (new comments in the restart fix only)

Kept: 1. `std::process::exit` does not run destructors; that is the crash the test has to produce.
Deletions: 0. No files edited.
MUST KILL: none.

Comments already on `c9534f00` in `lease/guard.rs` (foreign-process identity; nonempty lease destination) are outside this scan.

## Narrow deficiencies (do not drop the scoped 9)

- Republish wording can name the two Core panics that are not the mismatch string, and can stop citing `crash-red-before-fix.log` as the red run. The later decision row and `crash-red-reproduced.log` already carry the real red.
- Wait for Rust partition (2/2), runtime, web, and macos-storage-gate on this head before any merge decision. This review did not watch them.
